+# Bilibili Platform Adapter
+
+## Overview
+
+This adapter handles Bilibili-specific video upload and management operations.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```yaml
+platform: bilibili
+api_version: v1
+auth_type: cookies
+
+endpoints:
+  upload: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/vu/web/add"
+  cover: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/vu/web/cover/add"
+  info: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/vu/web/info"
+  analytics: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/web/data/archive"
+```
+
+## Limits
+
+| Property | Limit |
+|----------|-------|
+| Title | 80 characters |
+| Description | 2000 characters |
+| Tags | 12 tags maximum |
+| Thumbnail | 960x600px, max 2MB |
+| Video | 8GB or 4 hours |
+
+## Upload Flow
+
+```
+1. Authenticate with cookies
+2. Pre-upload video file (chunks)
+3. Merge video chunks
+4. Set cover image
+5. Submit video metadata
+6. Verify upload status
+```
+
+## API Requirements
+
+- Bilibili Creative Center access
+- Cookie-based authentication
+- Member account in good standing
+
+## Error Handling
+
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| `-101` | Re-authenticate (cookies expired) |
+| `-509` | Wait and retry (rate limit) |
+| `-400` | Fix metadata and retry |
+| `-403` | Check account permissions |
+
+## Analytics Metrics
+
+- play, danmaku, reply, favorite, coin, share, like
+- avg_play_duration, follower_incr
+
+## Special Features
+
+- Danmaku (bullet comments) support
+- Coin system for monetization
+- Multi-part video support
+- Scheduled publishing

+# YouTube Platform Adapter
+
+## Overview
+
+This adapter handles YouTube-specific video upload and management operations.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```yaml
+platform: youtube
+api_version: v3
+auth_type: oauth2
+
+endpoints:
+  upload: "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/youtube/v3/videos"
+  metadata: "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos"
+  thumbnail: "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/youtube/v3/thumbnails/set"
+  analytics: "https://youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com/v2/reports"
+```
+
+## Limits
+
+| Property | Limit |
+|----------|-------|
+| Title | 100 characters |
+| Description | 5000 characters |
+| Tags | 500 characters total |
+| Thumbnail | 1280x720px, max 2MB |
+| Video | 256GB or 12 hours |
+
+## Upload Flow
+
+```
+1. Authenticate with OAuth2
+2. Create video resource (metadata)
+3. Upload video file (resumable)
+4. Set thumbnail
+5. Verify upload status
+```
+
+## API Requirements
+
+- YouTube Data API v3
+- YouTube Analytics API
+- OAuth2 credentials with scopes:
+  - `youtube.upload`
+  - `youtube.readonly`
+  - `yt-analytics.readonly`
+
+## Error Handling
+
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| `quotaExceeded` | Wait and retry with backoff |
+| `uploadLimitExceeded` | Schedule for next day |
+| `invalidVideoMetadata` | Fix metadata and retry |
+| `forbidden` | Check OAuth scopes |
+
+## Analytics Metrics
+
+- views, likes, dislikes, comments
+- averageViewDuration, averageViewPercentage
+- subscriberChange, shares, estimatedMinutesWatched

Return JSON with:
1. "summary": Brief summary of what changed

  "findings": [...],

+# Bilibili Platform Adapter
+
+## Overview
+
+This adapter handles Bilibili-specific video upload and management operations.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```yaml
+platform: bilibili
+api_version: v1
+auth_type: cookies
+
+endpoints:
+  upload: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/vu/web/add"
+  cover: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/vu/web/cover/add"
+  info: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/vu/web/info"
+  analytics: "https://member.bilibili.com/x/web/data/archive"
+```
+
+## Limits
+
+| Property | Limit |
+|----------|-------|
+| Title | 80 characters |
+| Description | 2000 characters |
+| Tags | 12 tags maximum |
+| Thumbnail | 960x600px, max 2MB |
+| Video | 8GB or 4 hours |
+
+## Upload Flow
+
+```
+1. Authenticate with cookies
+2. Pre-upload video file (chunks)
+3. Merge video chunks
+4. Set cover image
+5. Submit video metadata
+6. Verify upload status
+```
+
+## API Requirements
+
+- Bilibili Creative Center access
+- Cookie-based authentication
+- Member account in good standing
+
+## Error Handling
+
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| `-101` | Re-authenticate (cookies expired) |
+| `-509` | Wait and retry (rate limit) |
+| `-400` | Fix metadata and retry |
+| `-403` | Check account permissions |
+
+## Analytics Metrics
+
+- play, danmaku, reply, favorite, coin, share, like
+- avg_play_duration, follower_incr
+
+## Special Features
+
+- Danmaku (bullet comments) support
+- Coin system for monetization
+- Multi-part video support
+- Scheduled publishing

+# YouTube Platform Adapter
+
+## Overview
+
+This adapter handles YouTube-specific video upload and management operations.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```yaml
+platform: youtube
+api_version: v3
+auth_type: oauth2
+
+endpoints:
+  upload: "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/youtube/v3/videos"
+  metadata: "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos"
+  thumbnail: "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/youtube/v3/thumbnails/set"
+  analytics: "https://youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com/v2/reports"
+```
+
+## Limits
+
+| Property | Limit |
+|----------|-------|
+| Title | 100 characters |
+| Description | 5000 characters |
+| Tags | 500 characters total |
+| Thumbnail | 1280x720px, max 2MB |
+| Video | 256GB or 12 hours |
+
+## Upload Flow
+
+```
+1. Authenticate with OAuth2
+2. Create video resource (metadata)
+3. Upload video file (resumable)
+4. Set thumbnail
+5. Verify upload status
+```
+
+## API Requirements
+
+- YouTube Data API v3
+- YouTube Analytics API
+- OAuth2 credentials with scopes:
+  - `youtube.upload`
+  - `youtube.readonly`
+  - `yt-analytics.readonly`
+
+## Error Handling
+
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| `quotaExceeded` | Wait and retry with backoff |
+| `uploadLimitExceeded` | Schedule for next day |
+| `invalidVideoMetadata` | Fix metadata and retry |
+| `forbidden` | Check OAuth scopes |
+
+## Analytics Metrics
+
+- views, likes, dislikes, comments
+- averageViewDuration, averageViewPercentage
+- subscriberChange, shares, estimatedMinutesWatched

+| Title | 100 characters |
+| Description | 5000 characters |
+| Tags | 500 characters total |
+| Thumbnail | 1280x720px, max 2MB |
+| Video | 256GB or 12 hours |
+
+## Upload Flow
+
+```
+1. Authenticate with OAuth2
+2. Create video resource (metadata)
+3. Upload video file (resumable)
+4. Set thumbnail
+5. Verify upload status
+```
+
+## API Requirements
+
+- YouTube Data API v3
+- YouTube Analytics API
+- OAuth2 credentials with scopes:
+  - `youtube.upload`
+  - `youtube.readonly`
+  - `yt-analytics.readonly`
+
+## Error Handling
+
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| `quotaExceeded` | Wait and retry with backoff |
+| `uploadLimitExceeded` | Schedule for next day |
+| `invalidVideoMetadata` | Fix metadata and retry |
+| `forbidden` | Check OAuth scopes |
+
+## Analytics Metrics
+
+- views, likes, dislikes, comments
+- averageViewDuration, averageViewPercentage
+- subscriberChange, shares, estimatedMinutesWatched
